title: fix(fields): a currency field's symbol no longer covers the first digits of the amount
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8NHehyCBedZBWrfcdTu3K4a)_

Fixes #36678

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在编辑表单里改金额时，像 US$、HK$、CHF 这样较宽的货币符号不再盖住金额的第一位数字；只显示 $ 的地方外观完全不变。
- 属于数据区的界面缺陷修复，来自你 11-23 浏览器评审的第 01 项。
- 出错的话只是输入框左侧留白多一点或少一点，不影响保存的数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The record edit form's currency input drew its symbol absolutely at `left-3` and reserved a fixed `pl-8` (2rem). The symbol comes from `Intl` per currency AND display locale (`currencySymbol`), so it is often wider than the `$` that inset was sized for: under zh-CN, USD renders `US$`, and `150000` read as `US$50000`.

- New `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/adornmentInset.ts`: `useAdornmentInset(symbol, { floor, startRem, gapRem })` measures the adornment span against its positioned wrapper (layout effect + `ResizeObserver`, so a late web font re-measures) and returns the narrowest padding class on a fixed ladder of static Tailwind utilities (`pl-6` … `pl-32`) that clears the symbol's right edge plus a gap, never below the call site's old class. Before layout (no width yet, or hidden) the symbol's character count stands in for its width. Spacing stays on static utilities: no inline style (`ui/AGENTS.md` §2).
- `CurrencyField`: the symbol computation moves above the readonly early return (the inset is a hook); the input's `symbol ? 'pl-8' : ''` becomes the hook's class, floor `pl-8`.
- `GridFieldWidget` (line-item grid cell editor): the card asked to check it. Same mechanism, same defect: a fixed `pl-6` for a `left-2` text-xs symbol, and zh-CN `US$` is wider than that. The cell's `div.relative` + span + control now render through a small module-level `CellAdornment` component (the cell renderer is a plain function in a loop, so it cannot call the hook itself), floor `pl-6`. Same DOM as before.
- A `$`-wide symbol gets exactly the class it had (`pl-8` in the form, `pl-6` in the grid cell): measured in the browser below.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

No new prop, no public export (the hook file is module-internal; `@object-ui/fields`' index is untouched).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/CurrencyField.symbol.test.tsx`, new top-level describe "the input reserves at least the symbol's width (objectstack#36678)": zh-CN USD `US$`, en-US CAD `CA$`, en-US CHF `CHF` each assert the rendered symbol and that the input's reserved inset is past the symbol's right edge (jsdom is given the box Chromium measured); `$` keeps `pl-8`; before layout a wide symbol still gets more than 2rem; the inset follows a currency change under the same input; a symbol wider than the ladder gets the widest rung.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.currencyMinorUnit-10355.test.tsx`, new top-level describe for the grid cell: zh-CN `US$` clears the symbol; en-US `$` keeps `pl-6`.
- Reverse verification (fix committed first, then the two widget files restored from `origin/main`, tests run, restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty): 6 of the new tests fail without the fix (the three wide-symbol cases, the pre-layout case, the currency-change case and the grid `US$` case); the two `$` pins pass both ways, as they should.
- Existing pins unchanged: `a field WITH a currency still gets the left padding that clears the adornment` (`pl-8` for `$`) and `a field with NO currency … no left padding` still pass as written.

## Acceptance notes

- The grid cell's overlap was established by the same reading (fixed `pl-6` against a `left-2` symbol) and the jsdom pin; it was NOT MEASURED in a browser: the showcase app has no line-item grid with a currency column to open.
- Kept out of scope: the list-cell editor path (`inCell`) draws the currency code in flow (`InCellTextInput`'s `leading`), so it cannot overlap and is untouched.

## Verification

Browser, showcase app, Projects → Website Relaunch → Edit, on this branch's base `6a731859` and on the fix. Measured with `getBoundingClientRect` on the symbol and the input's computed `padding-left`:

| Locale | Symbol | Symbol right edge | Text starts at (before) | Text starts at (after) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| zh-CN | `US$` | 39.9px | 32px (`pl-8`), covered by 7.9px | 48px (`pl-12`) |
| en-US | `$` | 20.8px | 32px (`pl-8`) | 32px (`pl-8`), unchanged |

Screenshots (attached in the project thread; GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only): before, zh-CN Budget reads `US$50000` and Spent `US$0000` with the `$` over the first digit; after, `US$ 150000` and `US$ 60000` in full; en-US `$` unchanged.

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/adornmentInset.ts`: the measurement and the ladder pick (riskiest hunk: the zero-width fallback that keeps the estimate).
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`: the hook call moved above the readonly return.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx`: `CellAdornment`.

Two-minute check: open any record edit form with a USD amount in a zh-CN browser; the amount's first digit is visible after `US$`.
